videos.title: Minecraft Tropicraft PORTAL (EASY) | Tropicraft how to get portal
how to get into the tropicraft biome

entry: THERE IS NO PORTAL FRAME. Entry is a sit-and-drink ritual on a beach at sunset. Three independent guides (E-kbN-E_8zU, sTI29iFrMTY, zpL-0WntAHQ) describe the same sequence.

1. Get tropicraft:pineapple_cubes by hitting an adult pineapple plant in a jungle/forest biome with a VANILLA sword. E-kbN-E_8zU is explicit: 'prepare any type of vanilla sword. Any type of sword from any other mods not work here.'

2. Get tropicraft:coconut from a palm tree, drop it on the ground and hit it to get tropicraft:coconut_chunk. zpL-0WntAHQ: 'grab a sword and you just go up to it and you have to whack a coconut up there... what you will get from this is damaged health.'
3. Collect ~20 minecraft:bamboo, craft tropicraft:bamboo_stick, then tropicraft:bamboo_mug. zpL-0WntAHQ: 'You put seven bamboos in a U shape.'

4. Craft a chair from 3 wool + bamboo, e.g. tropicraft:white_chair. E-kbN-E_8zU: 'This chair can have different colors depending on the color of wool.' A tropicraft:white_umbrella is optional decoration, not required.
5. Combine tropicraft:bamboo_mug + tropicraft:pineapple_cubes + tropicraft:coconut_chunk into tropicraft:pina_colada. tropicraft:cocktail also works (sTI29iFrMTY).

6. Place the chair ON A BEACH, sit in it, and hold-use the drink AT SUNSET. The portal opens and teleports you. E-kbN-E_8zU: 'Press and hold mug, watch on the sunset... you instantly arrive and appear in this portal.'
You arrive standing in a tropicraft:portal_water pool ringed with tropicraft:tiki_torch. Jumping back into that pool returns you to the Overworld.
boss_order: No boss ladder was captured. None of the three transcripts covers Tropicraft combat progression, so the ordering of tropicraft:eih, the Ashen and their tropicraft:ashen_mask_mojo drops, and any dungeon content is UNKNOWN from guides and must not be invented.
order: FIRST, before ever touching the dimension: assemble the drink. The mug, the pineapple and the coconut are entry prerequisites, not flavour crafts.

On arrival: the guides go straight to food security. tropicraft:pineapple can be replanted by right-clicking it on the ground to start a farm; minecraft:bamboo is 'the wood of this world' and plants like reeds with no water source needed (zpL-0WntAHQ).
tropicraft:lemon, tropicraft:lime, tropicraft:orange and tropicraft:grapefruit are picked bare-handed off fruit trees and each heal a small amount.
gates: HARD GATE - time of day: it must be sunset. E-kbN-E_8zU visibly retries and says 'Sometimes nothing happening... Maybe it is not a sunset. Maybe it is something near sunset.'
HARD GATE - you must be seated in the chair, on a beach, while drinking. Standing and drinking does nothing.
HARD GATE - the pineapple must be harvested with a vanilla sword; modded swords do not drop tropicraft:pineapple_cubes.
traps: If you do nothing after arriving, the portal teleports you straight back to the Overworld (E-kbN-E_8zU: 'if you not do anything, this portal automatically teleport you in the earth again'). Step off the portal pool immediately.
Whacking a coconut out of a palm tree damages you (zpL-0WntAHQ).
signature: tropicraft:pina_colada - the drink is both the entry key and the mod's emblem.
tropicraft:bamboo_mug, tropicraft:white_chair, tropicraft:white_umbrella - the beach-holiday furniture the mod is built around.
tropicraft:portal_water and tropicraft:tiki_torch - what the arrival pool is made of.
tropicraft:azurite_gem, tropicraft:eudialyte_gem, tropicraft:zircon_gem - the dimension's own gem tier (present in the jar; NOT covered by any transcript I captured).
